rachats.citation: Following the acquisition of Australian bottling company Coca-Cola Amatil, the company changed its name from Coca-Cola European Partners to Coca-Cola Europacific Partners on 10 May 2021.
CCEP acquired a 60% stake, while Aboitiz Equity Ventures acquired the remaining 40%.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
